offline_notes: One exact pin: packageManager, .bun-version, CI bun-version-file and the digest-pinned build image must agree; doctor compares the running process.versions.bun.
trustedDependencies is an explicit empty list: it replaces Bun's default trusted list so no dependency lifecycle scripts run unless deliberately added after inspecting the script.

bun audit --prod is the shipped-runtime gate; bun audit --audit-level=high is the whole-graph high/critical gate; full bun audit is recorded for lower-severity tooling triage.

js-yaml is overridden to 4.3.2 because @hey-api/json-schema-ref-parser pins 4.2.0; gen-check must still pass.
Run installed CLIs with bun --bun run so Node-shebang entrypoints execute under Bun and nothing is downloaded. Bun transpiling TypeScript is not type checking; tsc remains separate.
